_about: Benchmark labels for the 84 alert papers of 2026-11-05 (17 saved alert emails). Written by Claude on 2026-11-05 from each paper's title and abstract alone, against the topics of each student's reference-paper folder; no LitRoute data (scores, sent/dropped records, match-test) was used. target: the student(s) the paper belongs to; [] means it should match no one. optional: a student a match to is acceptable but not required. The labels were written after seeing LitRoute's scores, so they are not blind.

students.RP1-mh-risk: structures under multiple, combined or sequential hazards; multi-hazard design and resilience
students.RP2-pbee-res-recov: performance-based earthquake engineering: losses, downtime, recovery, resilience, post-earthquake usability, risk-targeted design
students.RP3-mf-sim: surrogate, multi-fidelity and reduced-order models; efficient simulation for seismic risk
students.RP4-mh-char: natural-hazard characterisation: interactions, compound events, climate non-stationarity, multi-hazard risk mapping
students.RP6-wf-emiss: emissions from burning structures and materials
students.RP8-doe-eq-unc-quant: uncertainty quantification, design of experiments and machine learning in earthquake engineering
